# TABLE1_SIG: paired t-test, Proposed vs each baseline (generated by `tools/sig_table1.py`)

Reproduces `code/pbe_seg/tools/make_tables.py` on `<workspace>/data/main` (not run against the server layout): per-image IoU `test.iou` of the five splits, two-sided paired t-test (`scipy.stats.ttest_rel`, df = 4, pairing by split index), Holm step-down over the 10 baseline comparisons within each dataset, alpha = 0.05. Mark in the table: a baseline cell is marked only if it is significantly lower than Proposed after Holm (a significantly higher baseline would get the up mark). n = 5 splits per cell, so power is low.

Cell format: mean difference (Proposed minus baseline), raw p, Holm-adjusted p. `*` = significant after Holm.
